categories.name: Kotadoria Silk
categories.description: Authentic Kota Doria sarees woven with fine mulberry silk and metallic zari yarns on signature Khat check grids.
categories.history: Kota Doria weaving in Rajasthan features the union of silk for luster and cotton for strength. The signature Khat grid creates a shimmering translucent drape cherished across royal Rajasthani celebrations.
categories.properties: Shimmering luster, lightweight Khat square grid, pure silk and zari blend, airy and regal.
categories.care: Dry clean recommended  ✦  store wrapped in soft cotton fabric  ✦  keep away from direct moisture.

categories.name: Kotadoria Cotton
categories.description: Featherlight, breathable pure cotton Kota Doria sarees featuring traditional Khat check patterns.
categories.history: Crafted for centuries by master artisans in Kaithoon, Kota. Cotton Kota Doria is prized for its cooling properties and delicate geometric square weave.
categories.properties: Ultra-lightweight, highly breathable Khat checks, skin-friendly natural combed cotton.
categories.care: Gentle hand wash in cold water with mild detergent  ✦  dry in shade  ✦  light starch if desired.

categories.name: Kotadoria Zari
categories.description: Kota Doria sarees framed with intricate temple and floral gold zari borders.
categories.history: Woven on multi-treadle pit looms in Kota, adding rich metallic borders to breezy translucent Khat bodies.
categories.properties: Pure metallic gold/silver zari border, geometric square weave body, royal festive elegance.
categories.care: Dry clean only  ✦  store wrapped in muslin cloth.

categories.name: Kotadoria Handblock
categories.description: Traditional Rajasthani Bagru and Dabu wooden block printing on authentic Kota Doria grid fabric.
categories.history: A celebration of Rajasthani craftsmanship pairing Kaithoon's Khat weaving with artisanal natural vegetable block stamping.
categories.properties: Eco-friendly vegetable dyes, intricate artisan motifs, soft breathable handfeel.
categories.care: Gentle hand wash separately in cold water  ✦  dry in shade.
